title: Charlottenburg Palace vs Sanssouci - Quick Summary
items: **Choose Charlottenburg for a compact Berlin palace day.** From Alexanderplatz, allow roughly 30 minutes each way. One interior and the free formal garden fit into about four hours without taking your whole day.

**Choose Sanssouci when the palace landscape is the main event.** The journey to Potsdam is roughly 65 to 75 minutes each way, and the park needs real walking time. Six to eight hours is the useful range.
**Weather is the best tie-breaker.** Charlottenburg is easier to control in rain. On a dry day with comfortable shoes, Sanssouci gives you the stronger park experience.
**Charlottenburg currently costs 12 euros for one main interior or 19 euros for charlottenburg+.** The garden is free and open daily from 08:00 until dark.
**Sanssouci Palace currently costs 14 euros, while sanssouci+ costs 22 euros.** Sanssouci Palace uses timed entry and availability can run out, so secure that anchor before adding other buildings.
**Do not treat the New Palace as a room next door.** It sits at the western end of Sanssouci Park, roughly two kilometres from Sanssouci Palace, and changes the route for the whole day.
**Monday is the obvious Charlottenburg trap.** From April to October, the Old Palace and New Wing normally open Tuesday to Sunday, while the garden stays open daily.
**Checked on 24 August 2026** against official SPSG visitor information and live public-transport journey samples. Recheck your exact date and route before paying.
